sources.snippet: Kabir Murjani is a machine learning researcher specialising in model quantization, efficient inference, reinforcement learning, and neural combinatorial optimisation. Research intern at IIM Bangalore; B.Tech Electrical Engineering student at Nirma University.

sources.title: GitHub - Kcbir/r_chessnano: A sub-50M parameter autoregressive ...
sources.snippet: ChessNano A sub-50M parameter autoregressive transformer that plays chess from pure notation. No board representation, no evaluation function -- just move sequences from Lichess games above 2500 Elo, compressed into a model that fits in under 60 MB and runs on a CPU. More details at kabir.codes.
